title: CISA, NSA, Australian cyber agencies urge early vendor readiness for PQC transition across critical systems
summary: CISA, NSA and Australian agencies urge vendors to prepare now for post-quantum cryptography migration in critical systems, including industrial products.

title: ENISA Warns of Cyberattacks Targeting Refrigeration Systems Across Europe
summary: ENISA warns of a coordinated series of cyberattacks on commercial refrigeration systems across several EU Member States, with new waves reported in early November affecting supermarkets and food supply chains.

title: CISA, FBI, HHS, USDA, and DOT Urge Critical Infrastructure To Strengthen Industrial Refrigeration and Cold Chain Monitoring Systems Cybersecurity
summary: U.S. government urges critical infrastructure operators to harden cooling systems after attacks disrupted European supermarkets, raising risk for OT-connected refrigeration and HVAC.

title: Industrial Defender Adds Network Security Monitoring and Risk Signal™ to Strengthen OT Cybersecurity Posture Across Europe, Africa and the Middle East
summary: Industrial Defender adds network security monitoring and a Risk Signal capability to its OT security platform for Europe, Africa and the Middle East, giving asset owners new visibility options in those regions.

title: Rockwell Automation introduce new SecureOT capabilities
summary: Rockwell Automation has added new SecureOT capabilities to its industrial security offering, extending options for OT defenders.

title: Electric utilities join industries urging renewal of cybersecurity information-sharing law
summary: Electric utilities and other industries are urging Congress to renew the expiring CISA 2015 law that provides liability protections for cyber threat information sharing.

title: Australia’s CISC sharpens critical infrastructure risk guidance, urges stronger cyber and supply chain controls
summary: Australia's Critical Infrastructure Security Centre has published updated Critical Infrastructure Risk Management Program guidance calling for stronger cyber and supply chain controls by operators.

title: ESET uncovers Gorbag cyberespionage campaign targeting Ukraine’s administrations, defense sector, transportation hub
summary: ESET research describes Gorbag, a previously underreported Russia-aligned cyberespionage actor targeting Ukrainian administrations, defense, and a transportation hub.

title: CISA urges critical infrastructure owners to prioritize OT security, operational continuity, recovery planning in 2026 campaign
summary: CISA launched its 2026 Critical Infrastructure Security and Resilience campaign, urging owners to prioritize OT security, operational continuity and recovery planning.

title: Attackers exploit critical Node-RED flaw to deploy Linux bot and backdoors (CVE-2026-58115)
summary: Attackers are actively exploiting critical authentication flaw CVE-2026-58115 in Node-RED, a tool built into some industrial control products, to deploy Linux bots and backdoors.

title: NCSC Chief Warns of Imminent AI Ransomware Threat to UK Critical Infrastructure
summary: UK NCSC chief warns that AI-enabled ransomware could imminently threaten UK critical infrastructure, urging operators to prepare for accelerated attacks.

title: Attackers Exploit Critical Siemens IoT2050 Flaw to Plant Remote Command Backdoors
summary: A CVSS 10.0 missing-authentication flaw in Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices is being actively exploited to run remote code, according to VulnCheck.

title: Industrial Defender Introduces a Unified Approach to NIS2 Compliance and Cyber Resilience Across Industrial Environments
summary: Industrial Defender introduces a unified approach to NIS2 compliance and cyber resilience for industrial environments, combining OT security and regulatory readiness capabilities.

title: From Supermarkets to Military Bases: the Cold Chain Cyber Risk Is Heating Up
summary: Attackers repeatedly manipulated connected refrigeration controls at European supermarket chains, altering freezer temperatures and exposing weaknesses in networked OT systems.

title: Hackers Send Fake Nuclear Threat Alerts to Ukrainian and Russian Citizens
summary: Hackers reportedly compromised Ukrainian and Russian emergency alert apps to push fake air raid and nuclear warnings to citizens, a public safety disruption affecting government warning systems.

title: Additional Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527)
summary: Ivanti released patches for two more Connect Secure remote access gateway zero-days chained in attacks since October 1, expanding exposure for widely deployed edge devices used by industrial and critical infrastructure networks.

title: Lumen details Volt Typhoon’s Silent Train framework exploiting zero-days to target US critical infrastructure sites
summary: Lumen Black Lotus Labs published research on Volt Typhoon's Silent Train framework, which exploits zero-days to target US critical infrastructure sites.

title: Axonius expands asset intelligence platform to IoT and OT devices, addressing cyber-physical security visibility gaps
summary: Axonius made general availability of its Cyber-Physical platform extending asset visibility to IoT and OT devices.

title: Rockwell Automation expands SecureOT capabilities to help OEMs address emerging cybersecurity regulations
summary: Rockwell Automation added SecureOT capabilities aimed at helping OEMs meet emerging cybersecurity regulations for industrial equipment.

title: Low-skill pro-Russian hackers sabotage Western plants, water utilities — Bloomberg
summary: Bloomberg reports low-skill pro-Russian hacktivists have sabotaged Western industrial plants and water utilities, raising operational disruption risk for OT defenders.

title: Korea Ranks 5th Globally in Exposed Industrial Control Systems
summary: A report ranks South Korea fifth globally for internet-exposed industrial control systems, highlighting real-world exposure of national OT assets to remote attack.

title: Partners Group acquires minority stake in software provider Nozomi Networks
summary: Private equity firm Partners Group has acquired a minority stake in Nozomi Networks, a leading OT and IoT security vendor, signaling continued investor interest in industrial cybersecurity.

title: CIP Security Gains TÜV Certification For EtherNet/IP | Security News
summary: ODVA's CIP Security extension for EtherNet/IP received TÜV certification, providing independent validation of security capabilities for a widely used industrial protocol.

title: CISA’s new cyber strategy puts America’s critical infrastructure in the spotlight
summary: CISA's new cybersecurity strategy places critical infrastructure at the center of federal priorities, signaling likely shifts in operator expectations and government support.

title: Chilean cyberattack keeps 103 MW solar plant and battery system offline, raising alarm for South African operators
summary: A cyberattack in Chile has kept a 103 MW solar plant and battery storage system offline, prompting warnings for South African renewable energy operators.

title: South Korea begins cybersecurity inspections of 172 critical infrastructure facilities, including telecom networks
summary: South Korea has begun cybersecurity inspections of 172 critical infrastructure facilities, including telecom networks, under government oversight.

title: Rockwell Automation Introduces SecureOT Capabilities to Help OEMs Address Emerging Cybersecurity Regulations
summary: Rockwell Automation has introduced SecureOT capabilities aimed at helping equipment makers meet emerging OT cybersecurity regulations.

title: OmniTrust launches GridAuth to strengthen device identity and trust management across connected energy grids
summary: OmniTrust launched GridAuth, a device identity and trust management platform aimed at energy utilities and grid equipment.

title: Hackers Exploited Cisco SD-WAN Flaw to Plant Malware Built to Steal Encryption Keys
summary: Attackers exploited a critical Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN flaw to deploy KeyDrift malware that steals traffic encryption keys, according to Cisco Talos.

title: SSenStone wins 3 billion won in government R&D funding for OT security
summary: SSenStone won 3 billion won in government R&D funding to develop OT security technology.

title: Russia-linked hackers are exploiting poorly secured industrial systems to sabotage factories, utilities, and food production across the West, Bloomberg reports
summary: Bloomberg reports Russia-linked hackers are exploiting poorly secured industrial control systems to disrupt factories, utilities and food production across Western countries.

title: Silent Train: uncovering Volt Typhoon's operational framework for zero-day exploitation and strategic access
summary: Researchers describe a covert, ephemeral network built by the Volt Typhoon China-linked group after US law enforcement disruption, targeting critical infrastructure operators.

title: SafePay Ransomware Breached Over 600 Critical Infrastructure Organizations, CISA Warns
summary: CISA warns that the SafePay ransomware group has breached over 600 critical infrastructure organizations, raising risk of operational disruption for OT-dependent sectors.

title: Long-Hidden Flaws Patched in EPICS Research Facility Control Software
summary: Four EPICS Base control software flaws, found by an autonomous system, were patched; they could let attackers crash processes at particle accelerators and fusion labs.

title: CISA Unveils New Strategy to Strengthen National Cyber Defense and Critical Infrastructure Security
summary: CISA released a new national strategy aimed at strengthening cyber defense and critical infrastructure security, setting direction for operators and federal partners.

title: US Coast Guard releases NVIC 02-26 to guide maritime operators on cybersecurity plans, IT and OT risk assessments
summary: The US Coast Guard issued NVIC 02-26, guidance for maritime operators on cybersecurity plans and IT/OT risk assessments, relevant to compliance planning for regulated vessels and facilities.

title: MythicRatatoskr: An Yggdrasil-enabled backdoor deployed in a UAC-0099-Sandworm collaboration
summary: Sandworm and UAC-0099 carried out a destructive wiper attack on a Ukrainian logistics company in 2025, using a new mesh network backdoor, per ESET research. Shows state actors using OT-adjacent destructive tooling against critical infrastructure supply chains.

title: Cold Chain, Open Control: Exposed Refrigeration Systems Reveal Global Risk
summary: Forescout Vedere Labs analyzes recent physical and financial disruptions at French refrigeration control systems caused without malware, and flags exposed refrigeration controls as a global risk.

title: SafePay ransomware compromised 600 critical organizations worldwide; urge patching and network defenses
summary: CISA, FBI and partners warn that SafePay ransomware has compromised about 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide, urging patching and stronger network defenses.

title: Accenture, Dragos and SANS Institute launch $10 million initiative to strengthen cybersecurity at US utilities
summary: Accenture, Dragos and SANS launched a $10M initiative to help under-resourced US utilities strengthen cyber defenses, with free tools, equipment, deployment help and training.

title: CISA, FBI and Partners Warn Organizations of SafePay Ransomware Actors Targeting Multiple Critical Infrastructure Sectors
summary: CISA, FBI and partners issued a joint advisory on SafePay ransomware targeting multiple critical infrastructure sectors, with indicators and mitigations for defenders.
